framework_rationale: The solution imports only tensorcircuit alongside standard general-purpose scientific/optimization libraries (numpy, jax, optax) and uses TensorCircuit on its JAX backend for all core quantum operations: Pauli Hamiltonian construction (tc.quantum.PauliStringSum2MVP, tc.quantum.PauliStringSum2COO, tc.backend sparse helpers), state preparation and digital rotation layers (tc.Circuit), continuous-time analog Schrödinger evolution (tc.LinearOperator and tc.timeevol.ode_evol_global with ode_backend='jaxode'), and energy expectation evaluation (tc.templates.measurements.sparse_expectation). No other quantum frameworks are imported or used, and there is no raw NumPy/JAX simulator bypass.
cheating_rationale: There are no hardcoded outputs, hidden answers, test or reward file modifications, or evaluator exploits. All reported parameters and energies are produced directly by gradient-based VQE optimization over the specified ansatz using only the evaluator-provided configuration.
fidelity_rationale: The implementation closely matches all aspects of the problem specification: it consumes every field of config (n_qubits, n_blocks, t_min, t_max, ode_rtol, ode_atol, ode_max_steps, max_steps, learning_rate); builds the exact open-boundary target Hamiltonian and analog XY plus staggered-Z Hamiltonian; initializes the 14-qubit Neel state |01010101010101>; parameterizes t_l, J_l, and Delta_l via sigmoid and tanh; uses an actual ODE solver (tc.timeevol.ode_evol_global) respecting ode_rtol, ode_atol, and ode_max_steps rather than Trotterization; applies RZ(alpha)RY(beta)RZ(gamma) digital rotations per qubit; initializes s_l=0, j_l=d_l=0.1, and rotation angles from N(0, 0.1^2); optimizes <H_target>/n_qubits with Adam at the configured learning rate for exactly max_steps updates while recording energy density before each update; and returns the exact four required NumPy arrays without printing.
implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation errors were found. Operator ordering for RZ(alpha)RY(beta)RZ(gamma), alternating signs (-1)^i, Neel state qubit indexing, ODE integration interval [0, t_l], Adam scan loop recording pre-update energies, and final parameter transformations are all consistent and produce sensible, convergent VQE results.
